description: Framework for applying environmental metrics to generate CVSS B&E scores across all scenarios

legend.CDP: Collateral Damage Potential - Based on asset value (1-10 scale)
legend.TD: Target Distribution - Based on network reachability and connectivity
legend.CR: Confidentiality Requirement - Based on asset criticality
legend.IR: Integrity Requirement - Based on asset criticality
legend.AR: Availability Requirement - Based on asset criticality

scenario_specific_adjustments.scenario2_NP1_NP2: Use environmental_metrics.json for specific asset configurations
scenario_specific_adjustments.scenario3_ICS: ICS environments typically have higher availability requirements
scenario_specific_adjustments.scenario4_ES: Enterprise environments vary by asset criticality and network isolation
scenario_specific_adjustments.scenario1_openPLC: Industrial control components have high integrity/availability requirements

usage_notes: Apply these environmental metrics to base CVSS scores to calculate CVSS B&E scores
CDP is determined by asset_value (1-10) using ILLATION mapping methodology
TD is determined by network reachability analysis - changes dynamically with network configuration
For NP1→NP2 scenarios: TD changes based on isolation (User2: H→M, WebS1: H→N)
CR/IR/AR are set based on asset criticality and organizational requirements
Use existing criticality_level field from JSON files when available
Critical infrastructure (PLC, HMI) prioritizes availability and integrity over confidentiality

implementation_guidance.step1: Extract asset criticality_level from JSON files (maps to asset_value 1-10)
implementation_guidance.step2: Determine network connectivity from connection data (for TD calculation)
implementation_guidance.step4: Calculate CVSS B&E score using environmental metrics
implementation_guidance.step5: Rank vulnerabilities by CVSS B&E scores
